nic_codes.description: NIC-2008 codes, 2-8 digits; only the leading Division fixes the industry. Provide these or a symbol.

symbol.description: NSE ticker whose BRSR Section A NIC codes stand in for nic_codes, e.g. RELIANCE

frameworks.description: Subset of frameworks to collate; null/omitted = all three. Omit "msci" for a table free of proprietary reference data.

topics.description: Deduplicated topics, sorted by convergence desc, then MSCI weight desc (nulls last), then pillar (E, S, G), then name

methodology.description: Which NIC Divisions grounded the table, how each framework was reached and at what match level, how variants were merged, how pillars were assigned

name.description: Deduplicated display name of the material topic, title case

description.description: 1-2 sentences synthesized across the framework definitions — never one framework's description verbatim

frameworks.description: The frameworks that name this topic — the 'coverage' column

convergence.description: Number of requested frameworks naming this topic; must equal frameworks.length

msci_weight_pct.description: MSCI avg_weight_pct carried onto the topic; null when MSCI does not name it or was not requested. For a Governance rollup row this is a pillar-level weight, not an issue-level one.

company_specific.description: MSCI applies the issue only to some companies in the industry (its 'CS' marker); null when MSCI does not name it

disclosure_topics.description: SASB industry-specific Disclosure Topics under this topic; null at a section-level match, where they are not industry-specific

as_named.description: The framework's verbatim label; multiple merged variants joined with '; '

code.description: Framework-native code: SASB GIC code, Sustainalytics MEI code, or MSCI Key Issue id

grouping.description: The framework's own grouping — SASB dimension or MSCI theme. Null for Sustainalytics, whose corpus stores no pillar.

prevalence.description: Share of that framework's matched industries flagging the issue

industry.description: The SASB industry this topic is specific to

turnover_share.description: Symbol path only: this Division's share of mapped turnover (0..1)

unresolved.description: Input NIC codes that resolved to no NIC-2008 Division

fy.description: Filing FY the NIC codes come from, e.g. '2024-25'

mapped_coverage.description: Fraction of the filer's reported turnover whose NIC code resolved (0..1)

matched_count.description: Framework industries the NIC codes crosswalked onto (0 = no coverage)

match_level.description: 'division' = exact NIC Division; 'section' = widened to the NIC Section, a sector-level answer; null when nothing matched

issue_count.description: Distinct issues this framework flagged before cross-framework dedupe

source.description: e.g. 'SASB Materiality Finder — 3 SICS industries for NIC Division 20'
